title: Reaction wheel failure
summary: One of the four reaction wheels seizes. Its stored momentum kicks the satellite off its target.
goals: Recognise a wheel failure in telemetry
Reconfigure attitude control to the remaining wheels
Unload the momentum the failure left behind
situation: The satellite points its antennas at Europe and Asia with four reaction wheels in a pyramid, any three of which can control the satellite. Two minutes in, a wheel fails.

steps.text: Remove the failed wheel from control: adcs.wheels DISABLE <n>.
steps.hint: Look at the wheel speeds: one drops to 0 rpm and shows FAILED.

steps.text: Get back into service (pointing within 0.2 deg) for 5 minutes.
steps.hint: If the satellite left NADIR, send ADCS MODE NADIR.

steps.text: Unload the stored momentum below 30%: ADCS DUMP NOW.
steps.hint: Without magnetorquers the thrusters do the dumping.

successText: Reconfigured. Three wheels are enough; the spare in the pyramid is there for exactly this.
